title: Runtime Context
description: The core execution identifiers threaded through every workflow-runtime call and response. Reused (via $ref) by the request and envelope schemas rather than redefined — see docs/architecture/workflow-runtime.md#core-runtime-identifiers. channel_id is nullable, not just the other three: the INVALID_EXECUTION_CONTEXT case (e.g. a caller sends a non-UUID channel_id) is exactly the scenario where no valid channel_id exists to report — echoing the malformed input back here would itself violate this schema, so the runtime context reports null rather than the invalid raw value.
